newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Reno Air cut to neutral.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Reno Air cut to neutral.

text.p: -- Lehamn Brothers analyst Brian Harris said he cut his rating on Reno Air Inc to neutral from buy due to reduced earnings expectations.
-- cut his fourth quarter eastimate to a loss of $0.55 a share from a loss of $0.22, and cut his full year 1997 estimate to a profit of $0.50 from a profit of $1.35.

-- He said he cut his estimates due to a more challenging revenue environment. Last week Southwest Airlines Co, which competes with 65 percent of Reno's system, launched another major fare sale, which could pressure Reno's yields through the first half of 1997.
-- Harris said he sees high fuel costs and tough revenue conditions continuing "well into 1997."
-- sees unit revenues rising by 4.3 percent in 1997, and unit costs up 2.2 percent.
